system.description:
Beginning at 10th level, at this stage in your training, you have deepened your connection to the elemental chakra that cloaks your body, allowing you to channel its power with greater precision and variety. You gain the following additional Martial Techniques.

Elemental Core. When you are forced to make a saving throw against a Ninjutsu, you may spend 2 Martial Die adding it to the result of your saving throw. If the jutsu cast has the same nature release as your Elemental Cloak you regain the spent Martial Die at the end of the current turn.

Ninjutsu Combo. When you cast a Ninjutsu, you may spend 2 Martial Die. When you do, you may cast it using your Taijutsu ability modifier and it gains the Combo keyword and the following effect language; Until the end of your turn, you can target one affected creature with a Taijutsu Finisher regardless of range, once per turn, using either an Action or Bonus action, ignoring its listed casting time.

Flashguard Counter. When you cast a jutsu in reaction to damage you take, you may spend 2 Martial Die. When you do, you collapse your elemental energy around yourself, manifesting a brief shield of energy, gaining temporary hit points equal to 5 times the result of the martial die. If the jutsu cast would grant you temporary hit points, you add the result of this technique to the jutsu’s temporary hit points gained, but you lose all temporary hit points at the end of the current turn.
